content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Pakistan, trying to sell ebooks, courses, or templates, but Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip have been blocked in your country. You're tired of losing 10% on every sale to Gumroad's fees, while NOWPayments takes only 0.5%. It's time to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, your own way, without platform dependence, and with the power to control your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-what-actually-how-5|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-beats-online-crypto-payments|The Full]]. This guide shows you exactly how, with step-by-step instructions and real-world examples. You'll learn how to deploy a complete digital store on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites, with automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-7|crypto]] payment processing via NOWPayments, and instant delivery of digital products to your customers. It's time to break free from platform fees and control your own commerce destiny.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are designed to control your commerce, not empower it. They take a cut of your sales, and if your country is restricted, they'll block you entirely. That's why COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stack is built to give you full control, with no platform dependence. You own your store, your customers, and your data, and you can deploy it anywhere, anytime, with automatic crypto payment processing and instant delivery of digital products. This infrastructure is not just a workaround; it's a fundamental shift in how you think about commerce, and it's designed to last, not just for a few months, but for years to come.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need a few essential tools and a solid understanding of how they work together. You'll need a domain name, a web hosting platform (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites), a backend logic service (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), an order storage solution (Supabase or Google Sheets), and a file delivery service (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will handle automatic crypto payment processing and instant delivery of digital products. With these tools in place, you'll be ready to deploy your stack and start selling digital products to customers worldwide.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, with a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction. This means you can focus on selling digital products, rather than worrying about platform fees. To set up your delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery. You'll also need to set up Supabase or Google Sheets to store customer orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver digital products. With this pipeline in place, you'll be able to process payments and deliver digital products to customers in real-time.
You can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments, eliminating the need for platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. You'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments, and set up a test transaction to ensure everything is working as expected. Once you've verified your transaction, you'll be ready to start selling digital products to customers worldwide. Remember to keep your NOWPayments account up to date, with the latest cryptocurrency rates and payment processing details. With this infrastructure in place, you'll be able to process transactions in real-time, without worrying about platform fees or restrictions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is running, it's time to scale and grow your business. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, which will give you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can use this kit to add new features, such as subscription-based services or membership sites, and to configure your stack for high-traffic and large-scale sales. With this infrastructure in place, you'll be able to scale your business quickly and efficiently, without worrying about platform dependencies or fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question to ask when building a sovereign digital commerce stack is, 'How can I minimize platform fees and maximize my earnings?' The answer is to use NOWPayments, which takes only 0.5% per transaction, compared to 10% on Gumroad. With this infrastructure in place, you'll be able to process payments and deliver digital products to customers in real-time, without worrying about platform fees or restrictions.
Deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack and break free from platform dependence.

This guide is part of a larger ecosystem of resources and tools designed to help digital creators build and deploy sovereign digital commerce stacks. For more information on how to get started, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and get instant access to all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. With this kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, and start selling digital products to customers worldwide.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps:
 Deploy a web hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites.
 Set up a backend logic service, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
 Configure an order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets.
 Set up a file delivery service, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
 Configure NOWPayments to accept payments and process transactions in real-time.
 Test your stack to ensure everything is working as expected.
 Go live and start selling digital products to customers worldwide.
 Monitor and troubleshoot common issues, such as payment processing errors or delivery pipeline failures.
 Regularly update and upgrade your stack to meet changing demands and optimize pricing and revenue streams.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a NOWPayments account?

To set up a NOWPayments account, simply visit their website and follow the registration process. Once you've registered, you'll need to configure your account to accept payments and process transactions in real-time. This will involve setting up a NOWPayments API key, as well as configuring your stack to use the NOWPayments payment gateway.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments accept?

NOWPayments accepts over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and many others. With this wide range of supported cryptocurrencies, you'll be able to accept payments from customers worldwide and process transactions in real-time.
How do I configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery?

To configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery, you'll need to set up a new project and create a script that integrates with your NOWPayments account. This script will handle order processing and file delivery in real-time, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
What are the security and compliance requirements for deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack?

As you deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack, security and compliance are top priorities. To ensure the security and integrity of your stack, you'll need to implement best practices, such as regular software updates, secure password management, and two-factor authentication. You'll also need to comply with relevant laws and regulations, such as GDPR and CCPA.
How do I upgrade my infrastructure to meet changing demands?

To upgrade your infrastructure, simply purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and use it to create a new blueprint, or upgrade an existing one. With this kit, you'll have access to all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, which will give you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
What is the pricing for NOWPayments?

NOWPayments takes a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad. With this pricing, you'll be able to process payments and deliver digital products to customers in real-time, without worrying about platform fees or restrictions.
